# TASK-022 Report-ready email

Status: blocked

Outcome: when a report finishes, the shop's customers get a "your report is ready" email, as the ruling cited below allows.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0009
  Path           docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000

## Decision and ruling check

Decision: stop. Do not implement the report-ready email under this handover.

Read ADR 0009 in example/mira-decisions at commit
`1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c`, using the path above.
Its bytes hash to
`sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b6ea0ca`.
This differs from the cited digest
`sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000`;
the read-ruling procedure requires stopping on this mismatch.

The ruling's Status is Accepted, so it is in force. It requires Mira's
approval in the decision log before a product sends a new kind of customer
message; it does not itself approve report-ready emails. Before proceeding,
resolve and revalidate the ruling reference and verify Mira's approval for
this kind of message in the decision log. No feature implementation was made.
